title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
synopsis: A boy, a mother in a hospital, an old enemy with a new mission, and a polymorphic cop who will not stop.

nodes.text: She is on the floor doing pull-ups while a doctor watches her on closed-circuit.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Hard.
“Bide time” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: John, scamming an ATM with a card reader of his own making.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take the cash” back. Reckless shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A truck driver in a leather jacket and a cop with no expression.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Trust.
There is no taking “Run with the cop” back. Doomed shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Get down. A pump shotgun in slow motion under a fluorescent buzz.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: Swear, says the boy, you will not kill anyone.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Swear it” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Sarah is calm in a way that scares the nurses more than the screaming did.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Break her out” back. Loyal shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Wait” back. Cautious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: An engineer at a kitchen table with a baby asleep upstairs.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Speak first” back. Mercy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Aim first.” The story records the instinct as “Hard” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Plans on the table for a chip that ends the world.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Persuade him.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Hard—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Lobby, security, helicopter inbound, the whole building one wrong shot from a fire.

choices.consequence: “Go up the stairs” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Direct—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Sarah on the radio: no killing.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Discipline—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Center mass” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: The chips spread on a table like a confession.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Burn it all.” The story records the instinct as “Final” and carries it forward.
“Salvage one” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Practical.

nodes.text: Police helicopter, then a SWAT van, then a helicopter again.

choices.consequence: “Drop down the wall” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wild.
You commit to “Stand still.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A tow truck, a liquid nitrogen tanker, an officer in mirrored shades.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Ram the tanker” back. Bold shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cautious—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Catwalks and forging cradles and rivers of orange.

choices.consequence: “Set the trap” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cunning.
You commit to “Run.” The story records the instinct as “Cautious” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The T-1000 in a hundred pieces of fog on the floor.

choices.consequence: “Shatter it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Final.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.

nodes.text: It walks back together from a puddle and laughs without lungs.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Switch weapons” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Arm pinned, gear wheel turning, the wrong man down for a beat.

choices.consequence: “Pull free” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
You commit to “Wait for him.” The story records the instinct as “Calm” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Molten steel under your boots and a hand reaching out of the bath.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Final.
“Step back” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: The CPU still in his neck. He thinks Sarah cannot do it.

choices.consequence: “Lower him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Final.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Heart.

nodes.text: The pulley wheel. A salute the boy will remember for as long as a person can remember.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Press it” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Headlights, road stripes, and an unwritten road ahead.

choices.consequence: “Drive on” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Hope.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: Skynet does not boot in 1997. You spend a long quiet decade waiting to see if it boots anyway.
nodes.sceneTitle: No Fate But What We Make
nodes.endingTitle: No Fate But What We Make

nodes.text: The chips are gone, the engineers persuaded, the date a rumor. A child sleeps. So do you, eventually.
You will hear the cradle in your dreams for the rest of your life. So will the boy. You will be grateful for both.
